name: Moi Moi
summary: A soft steamed pudding of peeled black-eyed peas blended with peppers, onion and oil, often with egg or fish.
story: Moi moi is a steamed bean pudding eaten across Nigeria, usually alongside jollof rice, pap or as a snack. It is made from peeled black-eyed peas blended with pepper and steamed in leaves, foil or containers. It is common at parties and weekday meals.

steps.title: Soak the beans
steps.text: Soak the beans in water for 10 minutes, then rub vigorously between your hands so the skins loosen. Float off the skins by filling the bowl with water, repeating until most are gone.

steps.title: Blend smooth
steps.text: Blend the peeled beans with the peppers, onion and a little water until completely smooth with no grit. Add water only as needed; the batter should be thick.

steps.title: Season the batter
steps.text: Pour into a bowl and stir in the oil, crayfish, stock cube, salt and warm water. The batter should be thick but pourable, like a loose cake batter.

steps.title: Fill the moulds
steps.text: Pour batter into oiled ramekins, foil cups or leaf wraps, filling about three quarters. Place a half egg or a spoon of fish in the centre of each.

steps.title: Set up steamer
steps.text: Arrange the moulds in a large pot on a rack with 3 to 4 cm of boiling water in the bottom, making sure water does not reach the batter.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Cover and steam for 45 to 50 minutes on medium-low, topping up with boiling water if it runs low.

steps.title: Check doneness
steps.text: Insert a skewer in the centre; it should come out clean and the top should be firm and slightly shiny.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Let rest 5 minutes before unmoulding. Serve warm with pap, jollof rice or bread.

tips: Peel the beans thoroughly; leftover skins make moi moi dark and grainy.
Blend until completely smooth for a soft, silky texture.
Do not let water touch the batter, or the moulds will be soggy.

swaps.swap: Use any black-eyed peas; skinless dried ones save time. Canned peas work in a pinch but the texture is softer.
Foil cups or ramekins covered with foil.
A spoon of fish sauce or ground dried shrimp.
